title: Log Management Policy
definition: Maintain at least three enterprise-managed time sources that the organization's information systems can use to synchronize time.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's operating system configuration benchmarks enable appropriate logging on all computing systems.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's network device configuration benchmarks enable appropriate logging on all network devices.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's business application configuration benchmarks enable appropriate logging on all business applications.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's cloud configuration benchmarks enable appropriate logging on all Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Maintain a system to aggregate all appropriate logs from each of the organization's information systems.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's aggregated information system logs are only accessible to authorized workforce members.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's aggregated information system logs generate alerts when logs have not been received from an information system after a defined period.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's aggregated information system is regularly tuned so that appropriate log events are alerted to the appropriate workforce members.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Define a process the organization will use to regularly review the logs aggregated from the organization's information systems.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's regular log review process includes clear Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for who should monitor aggregated information system logs, such as a Security Operations Center (SOC).

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Define a process the organization will use to automate the review of aggregated logs.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Define a process the organization will use to automate alerting on threats discovered by its aggregate log management system.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Define a process the organization will use to retain information system logs over time, including how long to retain logs of particular types.

title: Log Management Policy
definition: Maintain a log management system, such as a SIEM, SOAR, or service management platform, to track the status of alerts generated by the organization's log management system.
